sloka: ततः खड्गेन महता हत्वा तामिन्द्रिजित् स्वयम्।हृष्टः स रथमास्थाय विननाद महास्वनम् ।। ६.८१.३४ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ khaḍgena mahatā hatvā tāmindrijit svayam।hṛṣṭaḥ sa rathamāsthāya vinanāda mahāsvanam ।। 6.81.34 ।।

translations.english: The sound of his roar was heard by the Vanaras waiting for war standing not far from there, which was difficult for Indrajith to access.
